verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a SaaS research-agent product, so offering versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only describes the web-based autonomous research workflow, credits and pricing. Nothing mentions a public API, API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
